issue.title: 11 ACE TUI tests assert a full pytest tmp path in rendered panel text; the renderer truncates it with an ellipsis under the long agent-workspace basetemp
issue.description:
Eleven ACE TUI tests assert that a full pytest tmp path appears in rendered panel text. The renderer truncates that text with `…` when the path is long, and SASE agent workspaces export a very long pytest basetemp (`/home/bryan/.cache/sase/tmp/agent-tmp/<workspace>-<stamp>/pytest-of-<user>/pytest-N/<test>/...`, ~140 chars before the file name). They therefore fail in every agent workspace and pass under a short basetemp.

Failing nodes (all reproduced 2026-09-20 in workspace sase_32 at master 6087c0a8e, in the tests/ace + tests/service run and alone):

- `tests/ace/tui/test_agents_zoom_panel_files.py`: `test_completed_agent_zoom_loads_seeded_file_list_without_refresh`, `test_zoom_next_file_shows_next_seeded_file`, `test_zoom_prev_file_shows_previous_seeded_file`, `test_zoom_prev_file_wraps_first_to_last`, `test_zoom_next_file_wraps_last_to_first`, `test_zoom_next_file_wrap_survives_refresh_tick`, `test_zoom_next_file_reveals_file_panel_from_metadata`, `test_zoom_prev_file_reveals_file_panel_from_metadata`, `test_zoom_revealed_file_panel_pages_after_first_press`, `test_zoom_revealed_file_panel_reverse_pages_after_first_press` (first failing assertion at line 74: `assert str(first_path) in rendered`)
- `tests/ace/tui/modals/test_commit_view_modal.py::test_commit_view_modal_toggles_plan_and_restores_cached_diff` (line 527: `str(plan_path.resolve()) in _rendered_text(_build_title())`; the rendered title line ends `…` mid-path)

Root cause, verified: rerunning exactly these 11 nodes with a short basetemp passes 20/20 (the zoom file has 19 tests plus the commit-view node):

    .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/ace/tui/test_agents_zoom_panel_files.py tests/ace/tui/modals/test_commit_view_modal.py::test_commit_view_modal_toggles_plan_and_restores_cached_diff -q -p no:randomly --basetemp=/tmp/zc
    # 20 passed

Under the default agent basetemp the same command fails those 11. The tests are correct about the product behavior; their expectation is what depends on path length.

Fix direction (do not loosen the assertions to nothing): follow the precedent of closed sase-rv, which fixed the same class in tests/main/test_skills_handler.py by asserting on structured data instead of rendered text. Here that means asserting on the model/panel state or on a stable suffix such as the file basename, or having the fixture use a short tmp path. Do not shorten the renderer's truncation to make tests pass.

Not caused by the sase-11y.7 Services-tab phase: all 11 also fail at 244442ee8, the parent of that phase's last commit, and none of the files involved were touched by it. Found while verifying the sase-11y.7 gate repair.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Deterministic and path-length dependent, not intermittent. Every run in an agent workspace fails (reproduced in the parallel tests/ace + tests/service run, and again alone with -p no:randomly), and the identical 11 nodes pass 20/20 under `--basetemp=/tmp/zc`. The failing assertion is a substring check against text that visibly ends in an ellipsis where the long tmp path was cut, so the outcome is set by the path length, not by timing or ordering.

payload.description: Closed precedent for the same class: a renderer truncated a long pytest tmp path and the test asserted the full path in rendered text; fixed by asserting on structured data
Candidate cause for a repo-role label going missing: path truncation under the long agent basetemp (unverified)

payload.entry: Verified by the sase-14n land agent at master 87c604833. Phase sase-14n.5 (ac3091c3a) replaced the 11 full-tmp-path rendered-text assertions with exact structured assertions (panel.get_current_file_path(), modal._plan_document.path) plus basename-in-render proof, with no renderer change. tests/ace/tui/test_agents_zoom_panel_files.py and tests/ace/tui/modals/test_commit_view_modal.py pass under this agent workspace's default long basetemp, in a 230-node batch.
